summary: Verified the endless-rework mechanism by reading the code: mapMergeState ignores GitHub's mergeable_state so 'blocked' collapses to 'mergeable', the poller re-promotes /approve every poll via an unbounded pr_ready_to_merge path, and auto-merge's decideReadiness has no 'blocked' branch so a doomed merge's unreliable failure code misroutes to execution rework. Blast radius, host signal (mergeable_state, no extra API call), regression guards, delegated design forks, and the test surface are mapped in research.md. Premise confirmed valid — no premise_conflict.

files_in_scope: src/cli/bundled/plugin-docs.ts (bundled doc prose duplicates the merge-state/error mapping)

verification.note: node_modules is NOT installed in this worktree; run pnpm install / pnpm setup before gates.

key_findings.host_signal: pr.mergeable_state (REST, already on the pulls.get response the plugin fetches — no extra call). 'blocked' distinguishes protection-blocked from 'dirty'=conflict. reviewDecision is GraphQL-only, not needed.
key_findings.robust_fix_spine: Detect 'blocked' in readiness BEFORE calling mergePR, since the HTTP code of a doomed merge (405 vs 409) is unreliable and perturbed by the pre-merge thoughts push.
key_findings.loop_bound: Routing blocked -> existing terminal needs_human_merge (done) removes the task from the pr_review_pending poll set, bounding the loop structurally with no new counter.
key_findings.two_promotion_paths: formal-approval (derivePrEvents) and /approve-comment (poller shouldPromoteApproval) both converge on pr_ready_to_merge -> auto-merge; fixing decideReadiness covers both.

delegated_design_forks: escalation site: auto-merge only vs. poller too
terminal done (hand-off) vs. block-and-retry (resume+auto-merge after formal approval)
explicit loop bound only needed if task stays in poll set
'behind'/out-of-date-branch handling (must not land in conflict->rework arm)
escalation message: generic vs. enriched via getBranchProtection
